source.source_name: KBO/BCE Open Data (Crossroads Bank for Enterprises)
source.license: Licence-BCE-Open-Data (reuse; no direct marketing of personal data)
source.attribution: Source: Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (KBO/BCE), FOD/SPF Economie. No direct-marketing reuse of personal data.

access.note: Free registration + terms acceptance. Download via the portal (login) or SFTP (request kbo-bce-webservice@economie.fgov.be). Not anonymous; not paid.

transport.download_url: https://kbopub.economie.fgov.be/kbo-open-data/login (resolve file URL after login) ; or SFTP

pagination.note: One full ZIP (multi-file CSV) + daily update ZIP. Files: enterprise/establishment/denomination/address/activity/contact/branch/code/meta. Apply update files incrementally.

snapshot.note: Load each CSV; join denomination/address/activity/contact on EntityNumber; establishments on EnterpriseNumber; resolve codes via code.csv.

parsing.notes: EnterpriseNumber/EstablishmentNumber stay strings (dotted format). EntityNumber is polymorphic (enterprise or establishment). Resolve Status/JuridicalForm/NACE via code.csv (multilingual). TypeOfEnterprise=1 -> PII. Pick one denomination Language consistently.

mapping_rules.legal_name: denomination where TypeOfDenomination=001 (social name), one language.

fixture_requirements: legal entity (TypeOfEnterprise=2) with denomination + address + MAIN NACE

live_test_plan.smoke: With KBO creds, download the full ZIP; assert enterprise.csv has EnterpriseNumber + Status and code.csv resolves JuridicalForm.
live_test_plan.full: Behind KBO_OPEN_DATA_* env gate, download full + apply daily update files; load multi-file CSV; build the enterprise master + establishments; resolve codes; join NBB financials on EnterpriseNumber.

blockers: License: no direct-marketing reuse of personal data (GDPR).
